policy: One combined TASM1/2 Red kit; Overclock, Dragnet and Vortex are its final added skills. Hunter revision 3 with later player overrides remains authoritative. Player-confirmed Reel In and Web Yank, Sky Rake and v0.37.0 Meteor Catch ship alongside the retained appearance and earlier abilities. Eleven Black rows cost 1,650 XP within the 2,450-XP fourteen-row budget. Preserve purchases, native controls and progression; later skills await individual qualification and player verdicts.

new_rows.input: Ground/combo Down+A: pure pull of up to five distant enemies ahead; choose Y or Up+A afterward; R exits
Owned Black airborne Up+A: reel an eligible foe below/ahead into claw range; choose Y for Sky Rake. Heavy targets pull Miguel. R lets go; native air A/Down+A/X remain.
Owned Black air Y: connected descending talons and rising hooks, then extended heel flip; native chain eligibility. R uses owned Air Dodge or native fall.

Owned Black plain air A near an airborne light foe: grab, flip, fall and floor knockdown with one small bounce. Choose Up+A afterward; R releases. Heavy/no-target retains native Hammer Spike; air Up+A Reel In and air Down+A remain.
Down+Y next to a downed enemy
Web Yank zip, Up-pounce or jump into a boss while holding toward it

price_budget.scope: Moderate increase requested after v0.35.0 was judged too cheap. Apply only implemented rows; preserve owned bits, dependencies and XP. Full-route economy remains a player test.

combat_design.request: Make Black play and fight as close as possible to Miguel O'Hara in Across the Spider-Verse; make it fun. Revision 1 review: avoid one-trick pinning, answer bosses, add webbing and air combos, add rows as needed within the 2D mob/boss brawler. Revision 2 review: X for webs approved; remove Collar Toss and Lariat; add one skill that rewards a full combo meter like Red's Momentum/Overclock.
combat_design.supersedes: Hunter revision 2 (15 rows, 2026-10-23), revision 1 and the 2026-10-22 catch/carry/crash/chase proposal; local 2026-10-23 seven-row air/guard proposal (archived at docs/TASM_ROADMAP-local-2026-10-23.md)

suits.implementation_order: Player checks v0.37.0 Meteor Catch before the next slice. GPT-6.1 Terra passes all six metrics at least 8/10; Reel In was player-confirmed on 2026-10-27. Native mini-boss adapters remain deferred.

Fuller chest/back/arms on the preserved native rig; unrelated native motion clips retained
Six swept surface-mounted forearm blades and small talon tips
Red web cape and all cape geometry/atlas region removed

Purchased Talon Lift with manual held-B air follow-up and native R exit

Purchased Web Yank: grounded/combo Down+A gathers up to five distant enemies with independent scarlet lines and weak refs; pure zero-HP pull, no close/rake/upward attack or catch impact flash; Conductor/resistant-target hero zip. Independent bit83/event392; v0.35.1 price 100 XP.

Purchased Sky Rake (bit85/event394, 150 XP): connected private Black-only air claws and heel flip (v0.35.1), with v0.35.2 horizontal launch bias toward a three-unit forward landing. Native upward launch/gravity/collision, chain/hit timing and paid/unpaid R remain. Independent look/feel review on v0.35.1 was 8/10 each; v0.35.2 landing remains player-unconfirmed and was not rechecked in emulator.

Purchased Reel In (bit84/event393, 150 XP, requires Web Yank): airborne Up+A uses one scarlet tether and continuous cast/heave/recovery to bring a foe below/ahead into claw range for chosen Y. Heavy targets zip Miguel. Native velocity/gravity/collision, floor/R/interruption release and unchanged other inputs. Independent review 8.53/10 overall, presentation 8.2 and feel 8.4; player tested it and says it feels great (2026-10-27).

Purchased Meteor Catch (bit86/event395, 200 XP, requires Sky Rake): private continuous grab/flip/dive/impact, native collision and two-HP floor hit plus one small bounce; native input and cleanup controls qualify. Terra scores every metric at least 8/10; player verdict pending.
Eleven Black rows total 1,650 XP; the planned fourteen-row total remains 2,450 XP. Existing purchases, prior prices and dependencies remain.
suits.kit: Hunter revision 3: player-liked pure Down+A Web Yank and Reel In, polished Sky Rake and v0.37.0 Meteor Catch. Talon Lift -> hold B -> Y -> plain air A -> chosen Up+A on the bounce. Air Up+A stays Reel In; air Down+A stays native. R releases. Eleven current Black rows total 1,650 XP; later slices remain designed.

latest_feedback.summary: Player tested Reel In and says it feels great. Requested Meteor Catch next with a GPT-6.1 Terra rubric and every metric at least 8/10. v0.37.0 passes all six metrics; this does not imply player acceptance of Meteor Catch.
